resources.string: gst may not run as a VPN on this phone until you allow it.
gst could not set up the network. See its log in Settings.
gst may no longer run as a VPN on this phone.
%1$s removed this machine from the network %2$s.
Add a machine to join a network again.
The machines of the network show here once a link connects.
gst links your machines into a private network over SSH. Add one machine that runs gst, and this machine reaches them all.
This machine has an SSH key of its own.
Authorize it on a machine where you ran `gst up`.
Reach every machine by its name, such as devbox.gst.
This machine is in the network now. Its machines show on the first screen as they answer.
Enter the SSH login of a machine where you ran `gst up`. This machine links to it, and reaches every machine of its network.
Another key is recorded for %1$s. Unless someone replaced the server\'s key, something else answers in its place.
This machine has not seen %1$s before. Compare the fingerprint with the server\'s own before you trust it.
To see it on the server, run
The server does not accept this machine\'s key yet. Log in to it as %1$s from a machine that can, and run this command.
It adds this machine\'s public key to `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`. The private key never leaves this machine.
gst keeps trying in the background, and the machines show on the first screen once the link connects.
Run `gst up` on that machine, with the same version of gst as here. The link then connects by itself.
This machine is no longer in the network
This machine has no gst IP yet. Run `gst up` on it.
This machine drops its links and forgets the other machines. It joins a network again when you add a machine.
Every machine drops its links to it and forgets it. It comes back only when someone adds it again.
Other machines reach this machine as %1$s.gst.
Use 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
This machine stops using its current key. Machines that authorized it accept the new one once it is in their `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`.
A machine lets this machine link to it once this line is in its `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`. The private key never leaves this machine.
Swipe a link to remove it. Its machine stays in the network.
This machine has no links yet. Add a machine on the first screen.
